modules.name: instructions
modules.summary: The agent entry point, the harness bridge, path-scoped rule sources, and the render pipeline. The one module every repo installs.

modules.name: adr
modules.summary: Numbered, immutable decision records, with an admission rule that keeps the directory from becoming a second documentation tree.

modules.name: backlog
modules.summary: Work items with stable ids, an eight-status lifecycle, a board, and the three gates that keep the bookkeeping honest.

modules.name: ci
modules.summary: One workflow that runs the gate registry, a matrix instead of a file per item, and a check that keeps it that way.

modules.name: findings
modules.summary: A register for what is noticed before it is decided, with a triage path into work items.

modules.name: gates
modules.summary: The gate runner, the registry every other module registers into, the run ledger, and the generic structural gate set.

modules.name: session
modules.summary: A handoff document carrying state between sessions: resume point, active constraints, and a dated archive.

modules.name: audit
modules.summary: A repeatable assessment whose output is rows in the findings register, never a document per subject.

modules.name: skills
modules.summary: Skill-authoring discipline and the gates that hold it: spec-pure frontmatter, descriptions that route, neighbours named, and output that lands somewhere.

modules.name: specs
modules.summary: Behaviour specifications with stable feature and story ids, per-story status, a mandatory scope section, and a gate against overclaiming.

modules.name: workflows
modules.summary: Decision procedures: how to decompose work, whether to reuse or build, and how much planning a piece of work earns.

modules.name: design-sync
modules.summary: An external design authority pulled into a local mirror, with every delta routed to a work item, a future item, or an upstream change request — never silent divergence.

modules.name: release
modules.summary: Candidate, stable and deploy branch lines; one procedure for cutting a release, hotfixing and rolling back; changelog fragments instead of a shared file.

modules.name: doc-authority
modules.summary: One owner per topic, declared in a registry and checked — plus a propagation gate for rules that live in more surfaces than their authority.

modules.name: concurrency
modules.summary: Many sessions on one integration branch: a verified base to cut from, attributed failures, a land protocol that cannot redden the branch, and merge drivers per conflict class.
